column_desc: Order date (format: YYYY-MM-DD, period: 2025-05-01 (Thu) to 2025-05-14 (Wed)). Public holidays in the period: 2025-05-05 (Mon, Children's Day and Buddha's Birthday) and 2025-05-06 (Tue, substitute holiday)

Name of the ordered product. One row is one order, and an order holds exactly one product (there is no order id column; number of rows = number of orders). Each product has one fixed category, size and list price
Product category (Ready Meal/Meal Kit/Salad, Fruit/Nuts/Rice, Vegetables, Meat/Processed Meat/Egg, Dairy, Coffee/Tea, Bakery, Health Supplements)
Size or pack of one unit of the product (e.g., 300g, 1L, 10-pack). Fixed per product
Number of units of the product in the order
Amount paid for the order (unit: KRW) = list price x Qty x (1 - discount rate), after the promotion discount
District of the shipping address (10 districts of Seoul: Songpa-gu, Gangnam-gu, Seocho-gu, Mapo-gu, Gangseo-gu, Nowon-gu, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Gwangjin-gu, Seongdong-gu, Yongsan-gu)
City/province of the shipping address (every order is Seoul)
Postal code of the shipping address: a 5-digit string, leading zero included (e.g., 05510)

Promotion code applied to the order; empty if none. WEEKEND20 is the only code: applied automatically to every order on a Saturday or Sunday, 20% off. Not applied on the public holidays (2025-05-05, 05-06)
